Dana: FYI — noticed a regressed perf signal in staging after the CUDA 12.3 driver + Triton micro bump this morning. Small-sequence (seq<=64) 99p latency up ~18%. KV cache read latency also spiked. Pausing canary for the rollout.

Matt: ugh. numbers? did perf CI catch this or only prod/staging?

Dana: quick numbers from the smoke-run at 08:10: baseline (yesterday): 99p=48ms, p50=9ms. now: 99p=56ms, p50=10ms. throughput down ~6% for small batch sizes. KV cache read tail jumps from ~0.6ms -> ~1.1ms. perf-ci didn't block the merge (tests passed), but the more realistic small-seq suite on staging shows the delta.

Anya: any kernel/profiler output? my guess is kernel selection drift (cublas/cudnn heuristics changed) or Triton auto-tuner picking a different kernel variant.

Dana: pasted trimmed perf profile below:
```
Perf summary: after driver+triton bump
- Top wall time increase: aten::scaled_dot_product_attention +22%
- triton::gemm_32x32 shows +12% latency variance
- fused_attention kernel (our optimized path) invoked ~30% less for seq=32; runtime routed to aten fallback
- KV cache path: device memcpy + kernel handshake increased, read path 1.8x slower on average

Stack: runtime v1.14.3 + Triton 2.2.1 + CUDA 12.3.14-driver
```

Sam: thanks — I'll start a bisect across the two changes (driver vs triton). can you drop the exact CI job id for the staging run?

Dana: staging run is perf/staging-smallseq/2026-03-18-0810 (artifact linked).

perf-ci-bot: perf/staging-smallseq/2026-03-18-0810 failed threshold: 99p latency +18%. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/2026-03-18-0810.

Sam: starting bisect: will deploy runtime with Triton pinned to previous patch (2.2.0) but keep CUDA driver at 12.3, then swap to previous driver + new Triton, measure. should isolate. ETA ~45m.

Anya: also add a debug flag to force kernel-selection to prefer our fused_attention path for seq<=64 so we can validate whether fallback is the main culprit (cheap hotfix). runtime has KERNEL_SEL_OVERRIDE env.

Dana: did that on one canary: set KERNEL_SEL_OVERRIDE=prefer_fused_attention. early numbers: 99p back down to ~50ms (partial recovery). suggests kernel-selection fallback is big factor.

Lee: interesting — CUDA/CuBLAS heuristics in 12.3 changed auto-tune behavior; Triton auto-tuner likely saw different timings and chose different gemm/attention kernels. We should: 1) finish bisect to confirm whether Triton bump or driver caused tuning differences, 2) land runtime guard (KERNEL_SEL_OVERRIDE default for small-seq) while we decide, 3) open a revert PR for the more risky component if needed.

Sam: bisect results:
- scenario A (Triton=2.2.0, CUDA=12.3-driver): still regressed (~+12% 99p)
- scenario B (Triton=2.2.1, CUDA=12.2-driver): minimal regression (~+3%)
=> points to CUDA 12.3 driver as the main delta.

Matt: good catch. so driver autotune change causing Triton to pick different kernels. do we have a minimal repro for upstream bug report to NVIDIA? need kernel names + PTX timings.

Dana: collected microbench repro for seq=32, batch=1, run on both drivers. attached flame and kernel names in artifacts. Repro command: `./tools/perf_repro --model t5-small --seq 32 --batch 1 --iters 200 --save-profile ./profiles/12x/`

Lee: for short-term mitigation, let's ship KERNEL_SEL_OVERRIDE=prefer_fused_attention for hosted and dedicated small-seq routes and keep the driver at 12.3 in new regions. I'll draft canary policy: enable override for 10% traffic on hosted, monitor for 01:00.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for r-infer-1.14.3 -> held due to perf incident. Manual approval required to continue.

Anya: I'll open PR to set the override default for small-seq in runtime config and add a toggle to disable it once we have a proper fix. Assigning Sam to open a revert PR against driver bump in infra catalog (if infra agrees) — but infra may prefer we file an upstream with NVIDIA first.

Sam: filing revert draft now and an upstream ticket to NVIDIA with attached profiles + PTX. Link to revert PR: https://git.redwood/infer/infra-reverts/pull/42 (draft).

Matt: action items:
- Sam: complete revert draft + NVIDIA ticket (priority P0).
- Anya: PR for KERNEL_SEL_OVERRIDE rollout (canary config).
- Lee: monitor canary metrics, set alert on 99p > +10% relative baseline.
- Dana: collect and upload any missing profiler PTX and kernel timings.

Dana: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Sam: update — NVIDIA responded asking for minimal repro and cuBLAS log. attaching ticket id: NV-BUG-2026-118.

perf-ci-bot: perf/regression/smallseq job re-run with KERNEL_SEL_OVERRIDE shows 99p within baseline (+2%).

Lee: if the override holds in canary for 2 hours, we can unpause the rollout and then decide long-term (driver revert vs tuned Triton config).

Matt: nice triage. keep notes in the incident doc and mark rollout-blocker until we have either revert or NVIDIA provides a patch/mitigation.

Dana: created incident doc and linked it in the ticket. will update with final postmortem once settled.
